title: ScriptaHub · A library for your curiosity

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You can take part as a reader, a critic, or a contributor.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with a subject you care about and see what the library contains.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Try a short edition when you want a first impression.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Continue into the full book when its questions deserve more time.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: If something needs correction, leave a precise suggestion through the book’s feedback action.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: If an important subject is missing, consider proposing it through Create.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Ask me for books when you would like help finding your next direction.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Bring your curiosity, and help make the next reader’s understanding a little stronger.
